Loss report: gitlab -> forgejo
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish job.if: approximate expression translation (GitHub compares strings case-insensitively)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish job.manual: workflow_dispatch trigger
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job and GHA does not; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
